cards.original_question: List the CRs whose affected clauses resolve to actual sections of spec 38.331 (clause-to-section matching).
cards.reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
WITH DISTINCT cr, rk
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected CONTAINS s.sectionNumber
WITH cr, s
WHERE (
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+|[A-Z]' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b)\\s*(?:(?i:sub-?clauses?|clauses?|sections?|annex(?:es)?)\\s+)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\.?\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\)\\s*)?(?:$|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '([0-9].*|[A-Z]\\..*)' AND NOT s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+'
      AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/#:~\\-])\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9_]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9-]+' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&])\\s*(?:[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.]*\\s*[–\\-:(/]\\s*)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\s*\\)?\\s*(?:$|[,;\\n&]).*'))
  )
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber

cards.original_question: List CRs on spec 38.133 that touch clause 4.2 (clause-level change filter).
cards.reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
  AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
WITH DISTINCT cr, trim(cr.clausesAffected) AS declaredField
WITH cr, declaredField,
     reduce(normalized = toLower(declaredField), token IN ['sections', 'section', 'clauses', 'clause', 'through', 'to', '~', '–', '—'] |
       replace(normalized, token, CASE WHEN token IN ['through', 'to', '~', '–', '—'] THEN '-' ELSE '' END)) AS chapterRange
WHERE declaredField =~ '(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])4\\.2(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*(?![A-Za-z0-9]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'
   OR (declaredField =~ '(?is)\\s*(?:sections?|clauses?)\\s+[0-9]+\\s*(?:~|-|–|—|to|through)\\s*[0-9]+\\s*'
       AND toInteger(trim(split(chapterRange, '-')[0])) <= 4
       AND toInteger(trim(split(chapterRange, '-')[1])) >= 4)
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber

cards.original_question: Which are the large CRs touching many clauses? List CRs affecting five or more sections of TS 38.214.
cards.reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.214'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL
WITH cr, reduce(clean='', i IN range(0,size(cr.clausesAffected)-1) |
 clean + CASE WHEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,i,1) =~ '[0-9A-Za-z.]'
              THEN substring(cr.clausesAffected,i,1) ELSE ' ' END) AS clean
WITH cr, [token IN split(clean,' ') WHERE token =~ '[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)*[A-Za-z]?[.]?'] AS tokens
UNWIND tokens AS token
WITH cr, CASE WHEN token ENDS WITH '.' THEN substring(token,0,size(token)-1) ELSE token END AS ordinal
WITH cr, count(DISTINCT ordinal) AS affectedCount
WHERE affectedCount >= 5
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

new_source_cards.original_question: What was agreed on UL Tx switching (Agenda 5.1) at meeting RAN1#100? (UL switching decisions)
new_source_cards.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '5.1'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#100'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.formalSourceContentWithTables AS content

answer_preview.content:
For standalone SUL, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2.
For each UL transmission occasion on a carrier, the existence of the switching period is determined one time every occasion.
Note: 2Tx carrier 2 refers to an UL carrier capable of 2 Tx chains and both 1-port and 2-port UL transmissions.

For SUL, if uplink Tx switching is configured, the state of Tx chains of last UL transmission is assumed in case of no UL transmission.
Work assumption: For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, the state of Tx chains of last UL transmission is assumed in case of no UL transmission. It can be revisited in RAN1#100bis.
If uplink Tx switching is triggered, the length of the additional time for PUSCH preparation procedure equals to the length of UL switching period.

For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, UE is not expected to be scheduled or configured with UL transmissions that result in simultaneous 1Tx transmission on carrier 1 and 2Tx transmission on carrier 2.

For inter-band UL CA, UE is not expected to [be scheduled or configured to] transmit on any of the two carriers in the switching period.
FFS: Whether to handle the case when switching period cannot be ensured by gNB.

Case 1 | 1 Tx on carrier 1 and 1 Tx on carrier 2
Case 2 | 0 Tx on carrier 1 and 2 Tx on carrier 2
For inter-band UL CA, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is at least applicable between 1-port transmission in carrier 1 and 2-port transmission in carrier 2.
